text:
marta (sec-eng): quick heads-up — steering committee asked for a compact plan to hand off RBAC & KMS access for the upcoming external pen test. need to surface audit gaps before we open the readroom.
jon (sre-oncall): +1. when is the assessor window again?
rachel (compliance): they want 2 business days of evidence packaging ahead of the start. assessor window is 2025-06-10 to 2025-06-12 per contract.
kevin (platform-eng): for RBAC: plan is to create a temporary role 'pt_assessor' with least-privilege, expiration 72h. we'll delegate via our iam-service and log all assume-role events to audit-bucket.
lucas (solutions): can we get a presigned link to the readroom artifact bundle? assessor access needs a deterministic path for evidence.
marta (sec-eng): yes — we'll publish manifests to s3://redwood-pt-readroom/<engagement-id>/ and generate a presigned URL with 7d TTL.
pt-bot (ops-bot): reminder: create_ephemeral_role --name pt_assessor --ttl 72h --audit true (automated audit export to gs://pt-audit-exports)
jon (sre-oncall): small request: add an export snapshot right before the window starts. last time we missed an evicted kube-controller pod log. snapshot should include: kube-audit, authz logs, and keystore-access events.
kevin (platform-eng): agreed. plan:
```
- Run: ./infra/scripts/export_audit_snapshot --services kube,authz,kms --dest s3://pt-snapshots/ENG-4321/ --tag pre-window
- Rotate: kms grant to pt_assessor via kms-delegate role only; no long-lived keys
```
marta (sec-eng): also important: RBAC change must be scheduled as a low-risk maintenance window so app teams can ack. I'll DM app owners and post a short form in #release-war-room.
rachel (compliance): note for report intake: anything labeled P0/P1 needs a Jira created and tagged with security:pen-test-ENG4321 within 24h of receipt. SLOs are in the runbook.
lucas (solutions): what about evidence redaction? assessors may capture sensitive customer data in logs. we should provide sanitized samplers and a redaction guideline.
marta (sec-eng): yep — we'll add a 'redaction_manifest.md' to the readroom and include sanitized logs + mapping. compliance sign-off required before giving full access.
jon (sre-oncall): re: audit logging — ensure CloudTrail/Control Plane logs are forwarded to our SIEM with a 90d retention policy for the engagement. last retest we had gaps between regions.
kevin (platform-eng): done. will add an explicit rule to the log-forwarder: include region tag and engagement-id.
pt-bot (ops-bot): checklist update pushed: https://git.redwood.ai/ops/pt-runbooks/ENG-4321/checklist.md
marta (sec-eng): two asks to volunteers: (1) someone to own the KMS grant window (apply/remove). (2) someone to watch audit export and confirm integrity checksum upload. can i get owners?
kevin (platform-eng): i'll take KMS grants. I'll put steps in the runbook and pre-run a dry grant.
jon (sre-oncall): i'll watch audit export + checksum. will post status updates to this thread during the window.
lucas (solutions): i'll coordinate evidence packaging and create the redaction_manifest.
rachel (compliance): i'll do the final sign-off on redaction & retention policy.
marta (sec-eng): excellent. action items:
- kevin: create pt_assessor role & kms grant play (due 2025-06-05)
- lucas: produce redaction_manifest & sample sanitized logs (due 2025-06-06)
- jon: run pre-window audit snapshot and confirm checksums (due 2025-06-09)
- rachel: final compliance sign-off (due 2025-06-09)
- marta: post maintenance notice in #release-war-room and add calendar block for RBAC change (due 2025-06-04)

kevin (platform-eng): putting PR: https://git.redwood.ai/platform/infra/pulls/1123 with IAM snippet.
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-eng-4321"
    }
  ]
}
```
marta (sec-eng): nice. kev — include a conditional: aws:RequestTag/engagement-id must equal ENG-4321. that prevents accidental cross-use.
kevin (platform-eng): will update PR.
jon (sre-oncall): and add a runbook snippet for emergency rollback:
```bash
# rollback ephemeral role
./infra/scripts/revoke_ephemeral_role --name pt_assessor --force
```
lucas (solutions): i'm going to draft the message to the assessor contact with the presigned link and the redaction guide. will loop in compliance.
marta (sec-eng): thanks team. i'll keep this thread as the single source-of-truth for coordination. once the roles are provisioned, reply here with the role arn and the audit-snapshot S3 path.
pt-bot (ops-bot): scheduled reminder set: 2025-06-04 09:00 UTC — pre-window validation.
rachel (compliance): quick note — ensure we capture proof-of-approval in the engagement folder (SIGNED_APPROVAL.pdf).
marta (sec-eng): will upload. closing loop: anyone see any missing edge-case?
jon (sre-oncall): need to confirm network egress rules for readroom. if assessors need external connectivity from staging, we must get network team approval.
kevin (platform-eng): noted — i'll open a net-ticket and add it to the runbook.
lucas (solutions): nothing else from my side.
marta (sec-eng): great. thanks. will post follow-ups and tag owners. :white_check_mark:
